scripts:
create service user demo-brainvire-service-user
set ACL for demo-brainvire-service-user
  allow jcr:all on /content
  allow jcr:all on /etc/packages
end

set properties on /content/dam/brainvire-demo-site/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/brainvire-demo-site
  set jcr:title{String} to "Brainvire Demo Site"
end
